target_session.name: Target session
target_session.hint: Where change notifications go. Leave empty to use the host's admin DM; if that is unknown the plugin only logs.

zh.name: 目标会话
zh.hint: 变化推送到哪个会话；留空则用宿主的管理员私聊，再取不到就只写日志不推送

mode.name: Push mode
mode.hint: direct = machine-formatted notice sent straight to the target; notice = wake the agent in the target session so it can respond.

zh.name: 推送方式
zh.hint: direct=机器原样播报；notice=叫醒目标会话里的我，由我处理

poll_seconds.name: Poll interval (seconds)
poll_seconds.hint: How often tibo.cc is fetched. Minimum 60.

fail_alert_seconds.name: API failure alert after (seconds)
fail_alert_seconds.hint: Only warn once the API stays unreachable this long.

zh.name: 接口失败提醒阈值（秒）
zh.hint: 连续拉不到数据多久才提醒一次
